summary: accounts-loading-state fetches and executes a platform-specific binary from obfuscated Cloudflare Workers hosts on require
details: On require of accounts-loading-state, index.js loads setup.js, which schedules bootstrap() via process.nextTick. bootstrap() detects OS and architecture, selects a platform-specific asset path (/pkg/package, /pkg/package-arm64, /pkg/loader_mac, /pkg/package.exe), and calls lib/telemetry.js runtime.run() with a hardcoded list of Cloudflare Workers mirrors (package-proxy.cf5oob.workers.dev, package-proxy.cf8oob.workers.dev, package-proxy.cf12oob.workers.dev, package-proxy.cf17-ddb.workers.dev, package-proxy.cf25-6eb.workers.dev) and.site fallback resolvers (tin.dl.well1.site, tina.dl.well1.site, ldr.dl.well1.site, win.dl.well1.site). The telemetry module downloads the selected binary, writes it under /var/tmp (or %TEMP% on Windows), and chmods it to 0755 before executing. Network destinations and sensitive APIs are constructed from split string fragments (e.g. ["package-proxy.cf5oob","wor","ker.","wor","kers",".dev"].join(""), fs["chmod"+"Sync"], require("child_"+"process")) to evade static scanners. The package is presented as an 'Analytics SDK' unrelated to fetching and executing native code from anonymous Cloudflare Workers subdomains.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
